newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spanish industrial confidence improves in Sept.
newsitem.headline: Spanish industrial confidence improves in Sept.

text.p: Spanish Industrial Confidence (ICI) improved in September to -6.3 from -10.3 percent in August, the Ministry of Industry said.
"Business opinion in the month of September shows growing dynamism in the demand for industrial products," the Ministry said in its last economic report.
The improved business climate stemmed from the favourable performance of the three classes it comprises: orders on hand, stocks and production trends.
